svg.title: MQTT write-back path to inverter hardware
svg.desc: Shows the full chain: Home Assistant publishes to an MQTT write topic, paho delivers it to client_on_message, which calls _emit_message, which calls gateway.on_message, which calls modbus_base.write_data, which calls write_register FC06 on the inverter
svg.text: — runtime: user changes a value in Home Assistant —

g.text: receives published message, fires on_message callback
calls self.on_message callback (wired to gateway.on_message at startup)
finds the transport bridged to the mqtt sender (Inverter1)
if not write_enabled: return (checks Inverter1's flag, not mqtt's)
looks up entry in Inverter1's holding registry map
if not write_enabled: return (second guard, same flag)
